page.overview:
Who is Varota?

Varota was a famed baliset maker and artist on the planet Chusuk.

Varota lived during the time of Leto I Atreides, a time where the art of baliset was declining. He was disappointed by the loss of apprentices applying to his studio.

His birth town on Chusuk planned an annual baliset festival in honor of him hoping to spur interest in the baliset again.

In the Dune RPG, "House Varota" was considered one of the Great Houses and the ruling house of Chusuk. The Game also gives the original Varota's full name as "Angostin Varota".
